verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents its own REST API across the accounting surface, plus an official NodeJS SDK and a Postman collection, so headless, UI-free automation of invoices, expenses, payments, journal entries and reports is possible. However, authentication is OAuth 2.0 with per-endpoint scopes, and nothing shows a non-interactive service-account or CI token flow, an official CLI, or CI-pipeline guidance. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive or machine credentials for CI, an official CLI or headless runner, CI/automation usage docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Get/set data from FreshBooks using the REST API.
